title: Title & Registration Services Late Lien Surcharge Schedule
content:
For lien charges on a Title & Registration Services order returned for a lien information error, the lien wait days are the calendar days from the lien wait start to the day the lien charges are collected. A late lien surcharge is added to the lien charges: ten dollars (10.00) when the lien wait days exceed sixty, five dollars (5.00) when they are thirty-one to sixty, and nothing otherwise.

| Lien wait days | Late lien surcharge |
|---|---|
| more than 60 | 10.00 |
| 31 to 60 | 5.00 |
| 30 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Lien wait start | Day the lien charges are collected | Lien wait days | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 31 March | 30 | nothing |
| 1 March | 1 April | 31 | 5.00 |
| 1 March | 30 April | 60 | 5.00 |
| 1 March | 1 May | 61 | 10.00 |
